summary.zh: 为混合物流设定规则，让不同物品自动走向正确出口。
summary.en: Assign routing rules so mixed items reach the correct destinations.

rules.zh: 玩家设定允许通过的物品类型，把混合输入拆成专线。未匹配物品必须有去处，否则可能阻塞；正确分类、误投与溢出构成反馈。
rules.en: Players define item rules and separate mixed input into dedicated routes. Unmatched items need an exit or can jam the line; correct sorting and overflow reveal rule quality.

decisions.zh: 精细白名单更可靠，但新增产品时需要维护。
decisions.en: Strict allowlists are predictable but need updating for new products.

decisions.zh: 保留回收通道占空间，却避免一个异物停掉全线。
decisions.en: A reject route costs space but prevents one stray item stopping the line.

effect.zh: 种类越多，记忆过滤规则越困难，分类界面越重要。
effect.en: More item types increase rule-management demands.

effect.zh: 允许自动退回会鼓励实验；不可逆污染会迫使先做测试。
effect.en: Automatic returns encourage experiments; irreversible contamination encourages testing first.

contrast.zh: 前者围绕双出口的选定物品分离；后者用多出口规则组织类型与溢出。
contrast.en: Factorio separates a selected item across two outputs; Satisfactory combines multiple output rules with overflow.

combination.zh: 让矿石夹杂有害碎片：玩家先观察颜色特征，再设计过滤线，错误材料进入熔炉会降低成品质量。
combination.en: Mix hazardous fragments into ore; players learn visual traits and build filters before contaminants damage product quality.

setup.zh: 混合运输带送来铁矿和煤，熔炉燃料口只需要煤。
setup.en: A mixed belt carries ore and coal; the furnace fuel input accepts only coal.

action.zh: 你把煤送入燃料支路，矿石走另一出口，并留出异常物品去处。
action.en: Route coal to fuel, ore to a separate branch, and provide an outlet for unexpected items.

result.zh: 正确物料抵达各自入口，一件混入的杂物也不会堵住全线。
result.en: Correct items reach their inputs, while an unexpected item does not block the whole line.

next.zh: 加入新品种物料后，检查过滤规则是否仍完整。
next.en: Review filter coverage when a new item type enters the network.

firstStep.zh: 只用三类物品、一个过滤节点和默认出口，显示每种物品最终走到哪里。
firstStep.en: Use three item types, one filter and a default outlet, showing each item’s destination.

pitfall.zh: 规则优先级与“没有匹配”必须可见，避免玩家只能靠反复拆线调试。
pitfall.en: Make rule priority and unmatched behaviour visible so players need not repeatedly rebuild to debug.

test.zh: 故意混入一种新物品，观察玩家是否能给它安排去处并保持原线路运行。
test.en: Introduce an unfamiliar item and see whether players route it without breaking the existing flow.
